title: Irish Teriyaki Burger
description: A twist on traditional Japanese Teriyaki, this burger combines Japanese flavors with Irish charm. The grill adds a smoky depth to the dish.

ingredients.name: Irish Beef Patties
ingredients.notes: Use 80/20 lean to fat ratio beef for best results

ingredients.name: Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, adjust to taste

ingredients.name: Grilled Onions
ingredients.notes: Slice into 1/2 inch thick rings for best results

ingredients.name: Melted Cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a mild Irish cheese such as Dubliner

instructions: Season beef patties with salt and pepper.
Grill beef patties for 4-5 minutes per side or until cooked to desired doneness.
Meanwhile, grill onions until caramelized and slightly charred.
Assemble burgers with teriyaki sauce, grilled onions, cheese, sesame seeds, lettuce, and tomato.
